title: Remove false-positive Bun placeholder tests while retaining genuine Rust and structural verification
description: Remove false-positive Bun placeholder tests while retaining genuine Rust and structural verification
no_spec_change_rationale: The cleanup removes always-green test stubs and narrows TypeScript test discovery without changing Corvid Hex runtime behavior or canonical requirement semantics.
acceptance_criteria: All always-green Bun placeholder and stub tests are removed; TypeScript discovery includes only genuine tests; cargo clippy passes with warnings denied; 273 Rust unit tests, 4 mmap integration tests, and 40 genuine Bun tests pass; strict SpecSync and Trust remain healthy.
